articles.title: Switzerland Votes Today on Whether to Stay Permanently Neutral Forever
articles.summary: Switzerland is holding a very important vote today. Swiss people are deciding whether to add permanent armed neutrality into their country's constitution. Being neutral means Switzerland would not take sides in wars or join military alliances, and it could also limit the country's ability to support international sanctions against other nations. Switzerland has been famous for its neutrality for a very long time. Supporters say staying neutral keeps Switzerland safe and independent. Critics argue that the world has changed, and staying completely neutral could make it harder for Switzerland to stand up for peace and human rights around the globe. The result of today's vote could reshape how Switzerland responds to future global conflicts.

lv1: What is Switzerland voting about today? (瑞士今天在投票決定什麼事情？)
What does it mean for a country to be 'neutral'? (一個國家保持「中立」是什麼意思？)
lv2: Why might some Swiss people want to keep their country permanently neutral, while others disagree? (為什麼有些瑞士人希望保持永久中立，而另一些人卻反對？)
How could Switzerland's neutrality affect its ability to help other countries during a war or crisis? (瑞士的中立立場會怎樣影響它在戰爭或危機中協助其他國家的能力？)
lv3: Is permanent neutrality in today's world a strength or a weakness for a country? Consider arguments on both sides. (在當今世界，永久中立對一個國家來說是優勢還是劣勢？請從兩方面分析。)
Should countries be allowed to stay neutral when there is a clear case of one side committing human rights violations? Why or why not? (當有一方明顯侵犯人權時，國家是否應該被允許保持中立？為什麼？)

articles.title: Scientists Achieve Major Milestone in Quantum Computing Using Exotic Particles
articles.summary: Scientists have made an exciting breakthrough in quantum computing. Researchers showed for the first time that special exotic particles called non-Abelian anyons can carry out the full range of operations needed to run a universal quantum computer. The experiment used 54 quantum bits, known as qubits, on a processor built by a company called Quantinuum. The team combined two techniques — called braiding and fusion — to make the system work. Quantum computers are far more powerful than ordinary computers and could one day solve problems in medicine, climate science, and artificial intelligence that are currently impossible to solve. This discovery brings scientists one important step closer to building a truly powerful quantum computer.

lv1: What are the special particles that scientists used in this quantum computing experiment? (科學家在這次量子電腦實驗中使用了什麼特別的粒子？)
How many qubits did the researchers use in their experiment? (研究人員在實驗中使用了多少個量子位元？)
lv2: Why is a quantum computer considered more powerful than an ordinary computer, and what kinds of problems could it help solve? (為什麼量子電腦被認為比普通電腦更強大，它可以幫助解決哪些問題？)
What do you think it means to achieve 'universal' quantum computing, and why is this milestone important? (你認為實現「通用」量子計算是什麼意思，為什麼這個里程碑很重要？)
lv3: Quantum computing could revolutionise medicine, security, and AI — but it could also be used to break encryption and invade privacy. How should society decide who gets to use this technology and for what purposes? (量子計算可能革新醫學、安全和人工智能，但也可能被用來破解加密和侵犯私隱。社會應如何決定誰可以使用這項技術及其用途？)

Some argue that powerful technologies like quantum computing should be shared freely with all countries, while others say they should be kept secret for national security. Which view do you agree with more, and why? (有人認為量子計算等強大技術應向所有國家免費分享，另一些人則認為應為國家安全保密。你更同意哪種觀點？為什麼？)

articles.title: 廢紙北上配額取消 香港回收商面臨低價困境
articles.summary: 香港廢紙出口內地的配額已經降至零，導致本地收購廢紙的價格跌至歷史低位，回收商生計大受打擊。由下月起，屯門的紙漿廠將成為本港廢紙唯一的出路，但回收商普遍反映收購價偏低，難以維持業務。廢紙回收是香港減少垃圾、保護環境的重要一環，若回收業萎縮，大量廢紙或流入堆填區，令環境問題惡化。事件引發社會關注香港回收業的前景，以及政府應否提供更多支援，協助業界應對困境。

lv1: 香港廢紙現時唯一的出路是哪裏？
為什麼廢紙回收對香港環境保護很重要？
lv2: 為什麼廢紙出口配額歸零會令回收商陷入困境？政府可以如何幫助他們？
如果廢紙回收業萎縮，香港的堆填區會面臨什麼後果？
lv3: 香港的廢紙回收問題，反映出本地回收業過度依賴單一出口市場的風險。你認為香港應如何建立更可持續的回收體系？
有人認為政府應補貼回收商以維持行業運作，也有人認為市場應自行調節。你支持哪種觀點？為什麼？

articles.title: 習特峰會預告重大成果 中美部分商品料周一降稅
articles.summary: 中國國家主席習近平與美國總統特朗普近日舉行峰會，雙方互動備受國際關注。特朗普打破美國過去逾60年的外交慣例，親自為習近平接機，被美國學者形容為罕見舉動。特朗普會後預告雙方將有「重大成果」，美國媒體報道指，部分商品的關稅降幅將於周一公布，內容或涵蓋歷史性採購協議。這次峰會對全球貿易和地緣政治具有重大意義，有望緩和中美之間持續多年的貿易緊張局勢，對香港及整個亞洲地區的經濟均可能帶來深遠影響。

lv1: 習近平和特朗普在哪裏舉行峰會？
什麼是關稅？它對買賣貨物有什麼影響？
lv2: 為什麼中美兩國之間的貿易關係對香港和亞洲其他地區也很重要？
特朗普親自接機習近平被形容為「打破慣例」，這說明峰會對兩國關係有多重要？
lv3: 中美貿易關係的改善，對香港作為國際金融和貿易中心有什麼潛在的機遇和挑戰？
有觀點認為大國之間的貿易協議主要服務於強國的利益，對弱小國家未必公平。你同意嗎？請從不同角度分析。
